value_case.statement: Repair IP/Sable compatibility activation after the owner updated DH from 3.3.2 to 3.3.3 and observed incorrect/missing portal LODs.
acceptance: Inspect exact installed DH 3.3.3 method and field contracts before admitting it.
Exercise prior portal regression tests against both supported DH artifacts.
Deliver a native-preserving IP/Sable candidate without modifying DH, Iris or the sound stack.
Record the separate reported jukebox crossing cutoff without conflating it with rendering acceptance.
